links.title: Agentic Very Much! Adoption of Coding Agent in New GitHub Projects

primary_link.title: Agentic Very Much! Adoption of Coding Agent in New GitHub Projects

papers.summary: In previous work, we investigated the adoption of coding agents in GitHub projects, finding that it was very significant. This study follows this line of work, but analyses new projects, that were created after the previous study. In this new sample, we find that the adoption of coding agents is more than twice as high. We also find that the adoption is significantly more intensive, as the proportion of AI-assisted commits is sensibly higher, despite strong signs that we do not detect all of it.
papers.summary_zh: 延續先前對 GitHub 專案中 coding agent 採用情況的研究，本文轉而分析在前期研究之後建立的全新專案。在新的樣本中，研究發現 coding agent 的採用率是之前的兩倍以上，且採用強度顯著更高，表現在 AI 輔助提交的比例明顯上升，儘管存在強烈跡象顯示並非所有此類提交都被完全偵測到。這一結果凸顯了 AI 模型在軟體開發中自主編寫程式碼的角色正以指數級速度增長，對開源生態與團隊協作模式產生深遠影響。
papers.title: Agentic Very Much! Adoption of Coding Agent in New GitHub Projects
papers.title_zh: 代理化程度非常之高！在全新 GitHub 專案中對 Coding Agent 的採用

Existing methods often misuse tools and exhibit biased tool preferences under 3D scenarios, leaving the agentic paradigm with only marginal gains over non-agentic strategies. We reveal that 3D spatial reasoning tasks are heterogeneous across scenes, while these agents apply a uniform tool-use strategy to all scenes rather than selecting tools according to the specific scene and task.
top5.summary_zh: 本文探討了代理式的 3D 空間理解，即多模態大型語言模型 (MLLM) 代理透過工具使用來執行 3D 推理。現有方法在處理 3D 場景時，經常誤用工具，並展現出偏頗的工具偏好，導致代理範式相較於非代理策略僅有微小的性能提升。本研究揭示，3D 空間推理任務具有跨場景的異質性，然而當前的代理卻對所有場景採用統一的工具使用策略，未能根據特定場景與任務選擇合適的工具。為了解決此問題，作者提出了 Skill-3D，旨在讓代理能夠動態演化出場景感知的技能，從而顯著提升其在複雜 3D 環境中進行空間推理的精準度與適應性。
